clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 微软公司Xbox裁员3200人，剥离工作室重组游戏业务
title_lines: 游戏业务利润率低，重组聚焦平

subtitles.en: Pretty much across the industry of technology, you see companies trying to rethink where they're spending money.
subtitles.zh: 在科技行业，很多公司都在重新思考资金投向。

subtitles.en: A lot of this is fuel because they're spending so much on AI and building our data centers and infrastructures that they're taking a closer look across all divisions.
subtitles.zh: 这很大程度上是因为他们在AI和数据中心上投入巨大，所以开始审视所有部门。
en_highlights: taking a closer look across all divisions

subtitles.en: So today Xbox is the one that we see really kind of getting that hammer.
subtitles.zh: 今天Xbox成了被调整的对象。

subtitles.en: They laid out a plan to cut about 20% of staff over the next year.
subtitles.zh: 他们计划未来一年裁减约20%的员工。

subtitles.en: And broader at Microsoft, it's a plan to cut about 64 hundred people.
subtitles.zh: 在微软整体层面，计划裁减约6400人。

subtitles.en: Again, just kind of trimming both an Xbox and sales trying to reorient for what they say will help them grow in this next era.
subtitles.zh: 这主要是精简Xbox和销售团队，为下一阶段增长重新布局。

subtitles.en: Brody, what is the rationale for Microsoft keeping Xbox?
subtitles.zh: Brody，微软保留Xbox的理由是什么？

subtitles.en: The CEO of the Xbox division wrote in a note to staff this morning.
subtitles.zh: Xbox部门CEO今早在给员工的备忘录中写道。

subtitles.en: And this is based on your reporting that Xbox is operating at margins three to 10 times lower than comparable businesses.
subtitles.zh: 根据你的报道，Xbox的利润率比同类业务低3到10倍。

subtitles.en: I mean, financially, it's not keeping up. So why does Microsoft want to keep it?
subtitles.zh: 从财务上看，它表现不佳。那微软为什么还要保留它？

subtitles.en: It's a good question. Microsoft really has traditionally struggled with consumer businesses.
subtitles.zh: 问得好。微软在消费者业务上历来表现不佳。

subtitles.en: You know, every time they've kind of tried to spin up say like a smartphone or things of this nature over history, it hasn't always gone super well.
subtitles.zh: 过去他们尝试推出智能手机等产品，但效果并不理想。

subtitles.en: Xbox, they've been traditionally committed to because it was this unique blend of hardware and software and they found a niche in it.
subtitles.zh: Xbox是硬件与软件的独特结合，微软一直很重视。

subtitles.en: And yeah, today is them trying to reorient that business into something that they can keep and grow for the long term.
subtitles.zh: 今天他们正试图重新调整业务，以便长期保持增长。
